integrity: Every finite certificate and checker is embedded with SHA-256 digests. The tree is a verified finite proof witness, and its check is not independent peer assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exact Littlestone dimension is proved at n=9 and sharp first n for depth six; only a lower bound is shown for n>9. Prior static fixed-profile results are not claimed new. Historical priority uncertain; independent audit not performed.
title: First depth-six online shattering for fixed-three-side partitions
